related.note: Same DMT laser 'code' phenomenon as telling 3, but Gallimore explains it as retinal laser speckle, not a code behind reality.

plain: A man named Danny says that shining lasers while on DMT, a powerful short-acting psychedelic, reveals a kind of code behind reality, and the neuroscientist Andrew Gallimore offers a plainer explanation. Gallimore says the grainy speckle pattern that laser light makes on the retina acts as "a sensory scaffold" around which, under DMT, a person sees complex forms. On his account, the "code" would come from the eye and the drug working together rather than from reality itself.
